title: Please do your research before buying any pillow
text:
Please do your research before buying any pillow. I won’t give this pillow a poor star rating since I didn’t purchase it. Because of the title which drew me in, I added it to my shopping cart, then did a little research. Do you really know what polyester is? Do you know how polyester effects your health? If not, a simple google search will give you this information. You may be checking all your linen, pillows, comforter labels afterwards. I sure did, and am beginning to make the switch for my entire family of four, which isn’t cheap, but certainly worth the money/investment into bette health. After all, your and your kids spend 8 hours a day laying on polyester/plastic. Scary stuff!
Wonder why Americans are getting sicker, more cancer, more autoimmune diseases from a slew of causes, but some are completely avoidable. Interesting fact. The same chemicals we use in our furniture, clothing, foods, bedding are forbidden and even outlawed in other countries. Especially those that offer universal health care. When the government knows they foot the bill when their citizens are sick, guess what they do? Try to keep the people healthier.
